criteria.description: Selects the activation behavior by which one most correlates with retention in the data (invited a teammate who joined, 78% vs 35% baseline), not a vanity action or intuition.
Explicitly dismisses vanity behaviors (created account/project) that barely beat baseline.
Defines a magic-number threshold with a time window (e.g. invite ≥1 teammate who joins within week 1), not just 'do X'.
Warns that the correlation may not be causal and proposes an experiment (drive the behavior for a random group vs holdout, measure retention lift) before betting on it.
Recommends using it as the onboarding/activation target (with the ~20% today → headroom) and a guardrail against gaming it without real value.
